title: Learning a Variational Network for Reconstruction of Accelerated MRI Data
layout_note: (a) Data processing pipeline: sensitivity-map stack (top left) and multi-coil k-space stack (bottom left) both feed an A* box that gives the zero-filled image, and both also run straight into a tall Variational Network box that outputs the reconstruction. (b) Below, the network as a row of GD^1 ... GD^t ... GD^T squares, with GD^t expanded by two trapezoid zoom lines into a large panel showing the gradient step.
grouping: One saturated dark green marks every learned unit (VN box, GD squares, A* box), against a white page; the expanded GD step sits in a pale olive-green square-cornered panel with a thin dark outline. Sub-figures are labelled (a)/(b) with captions below.
shapes_depth: Flat square-cornered boxes, the dark green ones with white serif text. Coil data are decks of offset stacked slices with tiny axis labels on their edges (n_FE, n_PE, n_CH; n_x, n_y); k-space is drawn as a dark image with vertical sampling lines. Inside the zoom panel the learned filters are small grey kernel thumbnails (real/imaginary pairs) and the activations are blue curve plots, joined by Σ nodes with +/- signs; the data term is an inline equation λ^t A*(A u^t − f) on its own arrow.
proposed_highlight: The whole network is one tall dark-green box bigger than every other element in (a), and its single repeated step is opened in (b) with zoom lines to show learned kernels and activation curves as pictures.
lesson: Coil data are drawn as decks of offset stacked slices with their array dimensions (n_FE, n_PE, n_CH) printed along the edges, so the multi-coil axis needs no legend.
notes: venue unverified: arXiv comment says 'Submitted to Magnetic Resonance in Medicine' (remembered as MRM 2018, not confirmed here); year = arXiv preprint year. All text is set in a serif (Computer Modern) face.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: the variational network is shown as a chain GD^1 ... GD^t ... GD^T and the t-th gradient step is opened into a pale-green box below, tied to GD^t by two trapezoid lines

relations.form: panel (a) runs left to right: sensitivity maps and k-space stacks -> A* block -> zero-filled knee image -> tall green VN block -> reconstructed knee image
sensitivity maps and k-space each send one line into A* from above and below, and both also run straight on into the VN block, so three lines converge on VN
panel (b) unrolls the steps as three identical dark-green GD boxes on one horizontal line with ellipses between them, u^0 entering and u^T leaving
inside the zoom box the learned filters are drawn as small grey RE/IM kernel patches and the activation functions as blue curve plots, between the filter and its transposed filter
GD^t is linked by two diverging lines to an enclosed box beneath that shows the data-consistency term on the top line and the filter-activation-filter branches below, joined at two summation circles

channels.colour: dark green fill with white text = a learned or operator block (A*, VN, GD); pale green fill = the opened interior of one GD step; blue = the activation-function curves
channels.shape: square/rectangular boxes = operators, image stacks = data, circles with Sigma = sums
channels.line: solid black arrows only, carrying data; no line-style distinction between training and inference
channels.frame: the pale-green box frames one unrolled gradient step

quality.strengths: Inputs and intermediates are drawn as real data (coil sensitivity maps, k-space stack, zero-filled and reconstructed knee images) with their dimension labels; the unrolled GD chain plus the trapezoid zoom on GD^t shows both the iteration and its interior in one column; the filter/activation branches are drawn as actual kernel patches and curves rather than named boxes.
quality.weaknesses: Dark green is used both for the fixed operator A* and the learned VN/GD blocks, so colour does not separate learned from fixed; the data-consistency term lambda^t A*(Au^t - f) is typeset as a formula on the wire; in (a) the VN block is a plain box whose link to (b) is left to the captions rather than drawn.

insights.structure: Two stacked sub-figures: (a) a pipeline where sensitivity maps and k-space data feed an A* block to give a zero-filled image, and all three enter a tall green 'Variational Network (VN)' block that outputs the reconstruction; (b) a chain GD^1...GD^t...GD^T with GD^t zoomed via trapezoid lines into a pale-green box showing the gradient step.
insights.data: Inputs are real grey-scale coil sensitivity maps and k-space stacks with dimension labels (n_FE, n_PE, n_CH), images are knee MRIs; inside the zoom, learned filters are small grey patch pairs (RE/IM) and activation functions are blue curve plots.
insights.emphasis: All learned blocks share one dark green fill with white text, and the zoom-in from GD^t is the only enlarged region, putting the unrolled gradient step in focus.
insights.flow: Left to right in both parts; in (b) a data-consistency term lambda^t A*(Au^t - f) runs along the top and the filter-activation-filter branches run below, joining at summation circles with +/- signs.
insights.avoid: Part (a) uses a lot of whitespace and long elbow wires for a simple input routing; the sign labels at the summation nodes are small and crowd the arrows.

arrangement.units: two captioned sub-figures stacked vertically; (b) contains a zoom box drawn as a rectangle linked by trapezoid lines
arrangement.inputs_as: coil sensitivity maps and multi-coil k-space shown as image stacks
arrangement.shared: the GD block is repeated T times with shared structure
